java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeHierarchy.InheritedType

    • substitute

      public TypeDef substitute(TypeDef type, List<TypeDef.TypeVariable> shadowed)
      Substitutes the type arguments this type is inherited with, except for variables a generic method declares of its own, which shadow the type's variables of the same name.
      Parameters:
      type - A type in the scope of a method of this type
      shadowed - The variables the method declares
      Returns:
      The substituted type

    • erase

      public TypeDef erase(TypeDef type, TypeHierarchy.InheritedType boundOwner)
      Erases a type in the scope of this type, taking the bounds of its type variables from another type - the declaring definition, for a type already substituted into its scope.
      Parameters:
      type - The type
      boundOwner - The type declaring the variables
      Returns:
      The erased type
